title: Fixed DG cone and shift actions and linear lifts
statement: Let $A$ be a differential graded algebra over $\mathbf Z$, with right modules and underlying integer cochain complexes as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. An action on a fixed complex $C$ is a right $A$-module object structure on exactly $C$, with its unit and associativity laws. A shift action on $M[n]$ is such an action on the ordinary shifted complex, whose homogeneous action is the unchanged action of $M$ under the canonical degree identifications. A cone action for $f:M\to N$ is such an action on the ordinary cone complex $C(f)^p=N^p\oplus M^{p+1}$, whose two projections have the componentwise action. From these action data form the actual modules on these fixed complexes. A linear lift of a fixed chain map is the proof that it preserves these module actions, and gives the module map with exactly that underlying map. Use the right $A$-linear homotopy relation, category $K_A$ and canonical quotient functor of [def-sfb-dg-homotopy-structure].
